title: The Looking Glass
source_status: Original standalone project left untouched. A separate source reference copy was placed in this folder.
medium: Interactive browser mirror using camera access, canvas, and fog-clearing gestures
suggested_subtitle: An interactive fogged mirror for the browser
key_interactions: Requests and mirrors the user-facing camera.
Covers the camera feed with a generated fog layer.
Pointer or touch dragging wipes the fog away.
future_page_notes: Good candidate for an interactive/process archive case study.
Use the fogged and wiped stills as an initial before/after visual rhythm.
Capture a short video or GIF later to show the wiping interaction.
Mention camera permissions clearly if the live piece is ever embedded.
